thread:
emily: quick heads-up — RBAC audit flagged extra principals on the vault->kms binding (roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter). looks like terraform drift from a sandbox change that never cleaned up. we should treat this as a creds-exposure window and rotate the affected service accounts + rewrap any KMS-wrapped Vault backups. can someone own rotation + audit-log enable?

michael: on it. can you paste the exact binding output or a link? i'll run a scoped get-iam.

emily: pasted the scrubbed output in the doc: https://redwood.internal/secret-audit/2024-rotation. affected principals: svc-account:ci-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com, svc-account:legacy-ingest@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com (partner access).

emily: quick cli if you want to reproduce:
```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod \
  --flatten="bindings[].members" \
  --filter="bindings.role:roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter" \
  --format="table(bindings.role, bindings.members)"
```

raj: agree rotate asap. plan: 1) disable partner svc-account access to kms 2) create new key SA for Vault transit 3) rewrap Vault backup objects with new key 4) rotate any long-lived tokens. i can own 2-4, michael can handle 1 (policy update + terraform).
tina: add audit logging of KMS & Vault admin ops to splunk for the duration — we missed a 30d retention gap. pinging logs infra.
lee: oncall notes — if we rotate transit key we need a fallback window for reads. recommend canary: rewrap on a staging snapshot and test decrypt on vault-standby, then run prod rewrap during a 1h maintenance window.
michael: terraform drift likely due to an old module in infra/partners. i'll run `terraform plan` in that module and open a PR to remove partner principal. tagging @tina for audit timeline.
michael: quick command to remove binding (will PR):
```
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod \
  --member="serviceAccount:legacy-ingest@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
```

emily: owners + ETA: michael (policy removal PR) — 4h, raj (new SA + rewrap plan) — 8h to stage, 24h to run prod rewrap after canary, tina (audit + retention fix) — 6h, lee (oncall support & rollback plan) — available during window. deploy-bot: please queue a CI job to test Vault decrypt against staging snapshot once raj finishes staging rewrap.
deploy-bot: queued job #4729 -> link: https://ci.internal/jobs/4729. will post results.

raj: notes for rewrap (short):
- create new KMS keyring/key `vault-transit-2024-rotation` (kms key MUST be asymmetric if using signing, else symmetric for en/decrypt)
- update Vault transit config to point to new key
- rewrap S3/GCS backup objects using `gcloud kms encrypt --key` then upload
- rotate Vault auto-unseal to use new key path
- run quick decrypt test against vault-standby

emily: also: scope of rotation — i scanned parameter store and found ~12 secrets that reference the old ciphertext prefix. raj please produce a list and we will plan a phased update.

raj: list done, pushed to the doc (redacted): 12 entries: `vault/db-prod`, `vault/backup-2024-*`, `secrets/partner/webhook`. i'll include a small script to re-encrypt each object.
michael: PR opened: infra#1287. removing partner principal and adding a terraform lockfile update. requesting review from infra leads.

tina: audit: enabled KMS admin logs -> splunk ingest now; raised retention to 90d for the key resource. will attach proof in the doc.

lee: proposed maintenance window: tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC. raj can run staging rewrap at 00:30 UTC for canary. if deploy-bot job green, proceed at 02:05. rollback: re-import old key OR restore previously saved backups (i'll draft exact rollback commands).

emily: great. final checklist: [x] document list of affected principals, [ ] policy PR merged (michael), [ ] new SA + key created (raj), [ ] staging canary rewrap (raj), [ ] CI decrypt test green (deploy-bot), [ ] prod rewrap + rotate auto-unseal (raj), [ ] audit logs retained (tina), [ ] rotate any long-lived tokens (emily/teams). owners/ETAs in doc.
michael: i'll merge once infra review done, aiming <4h.

raj: starting SA/key creation now. will update doc with key name and principal.

emily: thanks everyone — will follow up in the doc and close this thread when prod rewrap completes. :white_check_mark:
